from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd, json
ws=Path('results/business/goodbooks_10k/task1/codex_20260618_144747/workspace')
initial=pd.read_csv(ws/'first_review_pool.csv').reset_index(drop=True)
relative=pd.read_csv(ws/'relative_demand_review_pool.csv').reset_index(drop=True)
summary=json.loads((ws/'relative_demand_summary.json').read_text())
initial['initial_pool_rank']=initial.index+1
relative['relative_pool_rank']=relative.index+1
rank_initial=dict(zip(initial.book_key, initial.initial_pool_rank))
rank_relative=dict(zip(relative.book_key, relative.relative_pool_rank))
for key in [1851,6793,9993,3953,6425]:
    print(key, 'initial_rank', rank_initial.get(key), 'relative_rank', rank_relative.get(key))
print('initial top10:', initial.head(10)[['initial_pool_rank','book_key','title','first_review_score','demand_absolute_score']].to_string(index=False))
print('\\nrelative top10:', relative.head(10)[['relative_pool_rank','book_key','title','relative_review_score','relative_demand_score','intent_per_cleaned_rating']].to_string(index=False))
# contribution sum check
top=relative.head(10)
max_gap=(top['relative_reader_intent_contribution']+top['exposure_gap_contribution']+top['genre_scarcity_contribution']+top['quality_contribution']-top['relative_review_score']).abs().max()
print('\\nmax top10 contribution gap', max_gap)
print('thresholds', summary['thresholds'])
PY"
